statement: When a local variational Hodge route is represented by a finite product of relative Hilbert factors, use relative smoothness over the ambient deformation base as the integrability certificate. Smoothness is stable under finite fibre products and base change, so after restriction to the marked Hodge branch it supplies the smooth point required by the proper/open/closed image certificate. Do not replace this with fixed-fibre smoothness, tangent rank, or a normal-sheaf slogan without a source-specific relative lifting theorem.
